verdicts.quote: When a spot opens in a class with a waitlist, the first eligible waitlisted member is booked into it automatically
Spots go to waitlisted members in the order they joined ... C never gets a spot before B does.
verdicts.missing: C-18 only says simultaneous joins get different positions, not which one wins the tie; no statement on whether membership tier or staff override can jump the queue

verdicts.quote: A member may be on any number of waitlists at once, including for classes that overlap in time (C-37: whose booking would overlap another class they already hold, is not booked when a spot opens; their entry ends)
A promoted member who cancels is treated exactly as a member who booked directly at that moment would be (same cutoff, same fee or credit return, if the app has any).
staff cancelling a class or a member cancelling a booking sees success; the freed-spot and notice work is completed within the times stated elsewhere
receives a notice by the same channel or channels the app uses to confirm a direct booking, naming the class, its date and time, and saying they are booked
Two bookings are cancelled at the same moment with 4 waitlisted: the 1st and 2nd are booked ... Nobody is booked twice and no spot is given to two people.
A waitlisted member who tries to book the class directly is told they are waitlisted ... The member is not booked through that path
If the booking or the charge cannot be completed, the member is not booked, not charged, and keeps their place on the waitlist unless they are passed over

Joins are never refused for reasons of length while the list has fewer than 100 entries. If an implementation limits the list, the join beyond that limit is refused with a statement that the waitlist is full
A cancellation made at a time when booking the class directly would be refused because booking is closed (for example the class has started) does not book anyone from the waitlist.
Lowering capacity below the booked number removes nobody and promotes nobody until the booked number is below capacity (C-27: Raising a class's capacity by k frees k spots for the waitlist)
every waitlisted member receives a notice naming the class and saying it was cancelled; nobody on its waitlist is booked or charged; the waitlist is empty.
Staff see each waitlisted member's name in order with the time they joined
verdicts.missing: No explicit entry record definition; C-50 lists outcomes and C-22 requires current positions, but whether position is stored or derived from join order is not stated

verdicts.quote: For a session that ended up to 90 days ago, staff see each entry's outcome (one of those listed in the clause on recorded outcomes) and when it ended.
No page, message or notice a member receives names or identifies another waitlisted member or the member who just cancelled; only their own position is shown.
Staff can see a class's waitlist in order, with when each member joined (C-62: Staff can remove a member from a waitlist)
verdicts.missing: Whether staff can promote someone by hand is not stated

verdicts.quote: The waitlist can be switched off, which stops new joins ... With the waitlist switched off, a full class behaves as it did before
Within 60 seconds of a spot being freed in a class whose waitlist holds an eligible member, that member shows as booked.
Capacity 10, 9 booked, empty waitlist: a member books directly and is charged as before; the same steps and same results as before the waitlist.
Immediately after release, each class shows the same booked members and the same number of spots as just before; every class has an empty waitlist; every existing full class offers the waitlist.
